[RFCS.3.5] An event trace uses the following atoms. `Field #` is the field
the atom occupies in `proto/atom.proto#Atom`'s `body` oneof, which is its wire
identity ([RFCS.16.1]); the `Atom` column is its body message, which is its
name. `SchemaDef` and `Slot` reuse the DSC allocations, and their rows are owned
by [RDSC.7.1].
